app_fee.value: International applicants pay $85 for a degree-program application (US applicants pay $65).
app_fee.quote: International applicants for degree programs and certificate programs: $85

fee_waiver.value: Waivers are granted only in certain situations and are requested through the intended graduate program, not the Graduate School.
fee_waiver.quote: To request an application fee waiver, contact your intended graduate program directly.

also.quote: In certain situations, an applicant may be granted a fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule; each program decides, so see the program record.
gre_general.quote: All questions regarding the GRE should be directed to your intended graduate program.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT overall 4.5 (new 1-6 scale) with at least 3.5 in speaking; for tests taken before 21 January 2026 the minimum was 80 overall and 19 speaking. Some programs set higher minimums.
toefl_min.quote: Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) iBT: overall score of at least 4.5 with a 3.5 or greater on the speaking section.

also.quote: (For tests taken prior to January 21, 2026: overall score of at least 80 with a minimum speaking score of 19)

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic minimum overall band of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) Academic Test: minimum overall band score of 6.5

english_waiver.value: The exemption is by country of degree and India is not on the exempt list, so Indian applicants need TOEFL or IELTS even with an English-medium degree.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants who have received a baccalaureate or a graduate degree in one of the following countries are exempt from the TOEFL/IELTS requirement:

also.quote: Some graduate plans of study may have more stringent requirements.

notes: Programs set their own deadlines, GRE rules and sometimes stricter English minimums; several department pages still quote the older TOEFL 80/19 iBT scale. Everything goes through the Fox Graduate School application.
